launches.title: 🎯 Dart: Cursor for Project management
launches.tagline: Plan projects by chatting with Dart, then hand tasks to AI agents to get things done.
launches.body:
Hey, we’re Dart, and we’re launching AI Chat and Agents on YC and [ProductHunt.](https://www.producthunt.com/products/dartai)

https://youtu.be/wdOTDKvaZS0

# **Problem**

Project management involves many hurdles. Tasks falling through cracks, team members wondering what they should be working on, and PM work that takes up more time than the projects themselves. Most project management tools force you to spend an inordinate amount of time on the “management” side instead of talking to users and building products.

Legacy productivity and PM tools have been slow to adapt to LLMs, and even the newer, better ones have only recently begun clumsily tacking on AI features in an attempt to keep up with the trend.

# **Solution**

We built Dart with AI incorporated from the ground up so teams stop managing logistics and start delivering outcomes. Most PM tools add “AI features.” Dart is fundamentally designed around AI: chat is the UI and agents are first-class collaborators.

* **AI Chat:** Chat to create projects, tasks, subtasks, timelines, specs, and reports. Then conversationally manage your projects as you go
* **AI Agents:** Invite our built-in or third-party custom agents to handle tasks across all roles such as marketing, design, sales, and coding
* **Plug into your stack:** Connect all your tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, n8n, Slack, Discord, GitHub and more

# **Our asks**

* 🎯 Try out Dart today! Sign up at [dartai.com](https://dartai.com/) and leave us some feedback.
* 😻 Support [our Product Hunt launch](https://www.producthunt.com/products/dartai)
* We’re hiring for dev and marketing roles! [Apply here.](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/dart/jobs)

launches.title: Dart - AI-powered project management
launches.tagline: The AI tool that will save you seven hours per week in project management overhead
launches.body:
# tl;dr

[Dart](https://www.dartai.com) is a fully-featured project management tool that uses AI to assist with roadmap planning, report generation, breaking tasks into subtasks, and executing on basic writing and design tasks. Teams use Dart in order to plan better and eliminate regular PM chores from their schedule, freeing up seven hours per week to focus on other work.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=78558&key=user_uploads/850757/7bf68dfc-c1d3-409b-8b7d-995cca92e54c)

# The problem

It's critical for teams to have some sort of project management system that works in order to stay organized and keep making progress. The issues arise when that project management process begins to take up an undue amount of time. Common processes like filling out and categorizing tasks, writing PRDs, cleaning out the backlog, and other ‘work about work’ are seen as simply the cost of doing business when using legacy tools.

# Solution

Dart provides a more intelligent project management suite that will save each person on your team seven hours a week in standard PM busywork. In addition to best-in-class management for tasks, documents, roadmaps, calendars, and more, Dart also boosts your productivity with a suite of helpful AI enhancements.

https://youtu.be/CMsBAv9CCyU

These AI functions include:

\- Automatic standup, changelog, and project report generation

\- Roadmap planning

\- Duplicate task detection

\- Subtask generation

\- Automatic Task execution with agents (currently for writing and design tasks)

\- Task categorization and filling (e.g. automatically assigning tasks to the right person)

\- AI-powered brainstorming

\- ChatGPT integration

# Our Ask

Try it out! [Dart is freely available](https://app.dartai.com/sign-up) to use now and start managing tasks with your team. We'd love to support and are always welcome to ideas or feedback.
